entries.text: [EMPTY 40]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_kari_message_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Montenevera Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_00

entries.text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Ryme,\nthe MC of RIP?
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_01

entries.text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_02

entries.text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_03

entries.text: Oh! You will need at least two Pokémon fit for\nbattle in order to challenge Ryme!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_nobattle

entries.text: Yo, yo!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_man_00

entries.text: It sounds like there might be a rap battle going\non over at the stage.
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_system_01

entries.text: This is MY time, and this is MY day!\nYou’re not gonna stand in my way!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_man_01

entries.text: Listen up, Ryme—your reign ends here!\nYou’re gonna get rung up by this pro cashier!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_man_02

entries.text: *BOOM chhh BOOM* *BOOM chhh BOOM*
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_system_02

entries.text: Pro cashier? Well, I’m about to check out.\nMusta got your rhymes on deep discount![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_01

entries.text:
Please—you think you can step to my game?
Fool, I got “rhyme” right there in my name!\c
I’m a specter from which there is no protector,
and victory unto me you will render when the
crowd sees you’re a mere pretender![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_02

entries.text: You wanna end my reign? Yeah—keep dreamin’.\nBuy a book of rhymes, kid, and start readin’![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_03

entries.text: *BOOM chhh BOOM* *BOOM chhh BOOM*
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_system_03

entries.text: I’m done—you won! My rhymes totally whiffed!\nBut I’ll be back—maybe after my next shift!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_man_03

entries.text: Hold up! Where you goin’? That’s all you got?!\c\n“After my next shift”? Seriously? Bars over jokes,\ncome on![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_04

entries.text: That was over way too fast. It gets boring wearin’\nthe crown if no one makes me fight to keep it.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_05

entries.text: Hey, my opener’s back! You here for a rap battle\nor a Gym battle?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_07

entries.text: I’m here for a Gym battle!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_select_01

entries.text: I’m here for a rap battle!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_select_02

entries.text: As if I even needed to ask![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_08

entries.text: Hah! You got jokes! We both know why you’re\nREALLY here.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_09

entries.text: You were captivated by that show I put on, huh?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_10

entries.text: I rap what’s in my soul, baby. Weavin’ words into\na symphony of poetry.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_11

entries.text: Don’t try it with me—you won’t last one round.\nI’m like Sableye: my Mean Look’ll lock you down!\c\nLike that! You feel me?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_12

entries.text: Heh. Well, let’s get to it—you’re a Pokémon\nTrainer. So battle me, and show me who you are![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_13

entries.text: My music’s not all that tops the charts—my skills\nwith Ghost types are the best around![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_14

entries.text: Lest you forget it, the name is Ryme, and I’m\nknown as the MC of RIP![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_15

entries.text: Dead or alive, let’s make this a vibe![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_16

entries.text: Hah! Great battle—chilling AND thrilling![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_17

entries.text: You’ve got spirit, kid. You earned my Gym\nBadge, all right![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_18

entries.text: And how about a VIP pass for my next show, too?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_19

entries.text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, it’ll be easier to catch\nPokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)], and they’ll listen to\r\nwhat you have to say, too![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_badge

entries.text: With 8 Gym Badges, you’ll be able to catch\nPokémon of any level, and they’ll be sure to\r\nlisten to what you have to say, too![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_badge_all

entries.text: I’m feelin’ so good that I think I’m also gonna let\nyou have this![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_waza

entries.text: Too bad it’s over! Make your way back to my\nstage sometime. Maybe next time, we rap battle\r\ninstead. Who knows?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_20

entries.text: I’m sure you’ve got some scary-good adventures\nahead. I’ll be cheerin’ for ya! Later![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_ghost_21

entries.text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nMontenevera Gym!
entries.label: gym_ghost_040_receptionist_04
